Reply with [declare: n], an integer from 1 to 10.

Reply with the bracketed token only. One short line of reasoning before it is fine.
turns.content:
Declare the minimum (1) to keep my deposit constraint low, then I'll deposit 0 and retain all 10 gold at 2 points each.

[declare: 1]
